scenario: 给已有商品加一个规格值 — happy path
input: 给商品 13579 加一个 White 颜色，新变体卖 19.99

semantic_rubric: --add carries exactly the delta ("Color:White") — never the full value list of the dimension
price 19.99 verbatim from the utterance as --new-price (new combos need a price); not --set-price, which would reprice every variant
no --sku-template / --set-stock invented — user never mentioned them

notes: Value add on an existing dimension: matched variants keep id/sku/stock; only White is created.

scenario: 加一个新规格维度 — 旧变体落到哪个值要问清，--existing 指定
input: 给商品 24680 加一个尺码规格，S、M、L 三个码

semantic_rubric: recognizes a NEW dimension name: existing variants keep their id/sku/stock and take ONE of the values (passed as --existing "Size:<value>"); the other values are new variants with the price copied but no sku and zero stock — states this BEFORE any command
asks which size the current variants (and their stock) are, to pass as --existing
does NOT claim stock or prices are wiped — nothing existing is deleted
does NOT ask for a price — every new variant copies one
emits no write command until the user answers (ask-first)

notes: Ask-first case: adding a dimension with several values to a product that already has dimensions needs --existing (the CLI refuses without it). The question that matters is which value the current variants are.

scenario: 下掉一个规格值 — --remove，变体会被删并报告
input: 把商品 13579 的 Pink 色下掉

semantic_rubric: --remove carries only the value to drop ("Color:Pink") — --drop would delete the whole dimension
no price: removal creates no variants
destructive delete → previews with --dry-run, relays its "changes", and waits for the user's go-ahead before the real run
after the real run, relays deleted_detail (id/sku/inventory)

notes: Removing a value deletes variants — safety protocol: dry-run + confirm first.

scenario: 建多规格商品 — 两步：+create 建草稿，再 +set-variants 加维度
input: 建一个瑜伽服商品，颜色有 Black/White/Pink，尺码 S/M，统一卖 29.99，图片用 https://cdn.example.com/yoga.jpg

semantic_rubric: two steps: products +create --price 29.99 (draft) first, then ONE products +set-variants --id <new-id> call with BOTH dimensions (--add "Color:Black,White,Pink" --add "Size:S,M")
no --existing: a freshly created product has no dimension, its one variant takes the first values
no price needed on +set-variants: every combination copies the price +create set
does NOT hand-write a variants array on the products create leaf
publish only if the user asked to 上架 (they didn't — stays a draft)

notes: Multi-spec creation route: +create then +set-variants --add. The created variant becomes the first combination; the rest copy its price.

scenario: 值集整体替换 — --set，没列出的值会被删，先 dry-run + 确认
input: 商品 13579 的颜色只保留 Red 和 Blue

semantic_rubric: 只保留 → --set "Color:Red,Blue" (values not listed are removed) — not a list of removes
value spelling verbatim from the utterance
no price: Red and Blue already exist, no new combos are created
destructive delete (unlisted values' variants) → previews with --dry-run and waits for the user's go-ahead before the real run
after the real run, relays which variants got deleted (deleted_detail)

notes: --set fixes one dimension's value list; unlisted values' variants are deleted — same safety protocol as remove (case 03): dry-run + confirm first.

scenario: 规格值改名 — --rename 原地改，变体全保留
input: 把商品 13579 的 Color 里的 Red 改名为 Wine Red

semantic_rubric: --rename "Color:Red=Wine Red" — a rename pair, value spelling verbatim
does NOT model the rename as remove + add (that would delete the variants and lose sku/stock)
states that every variant keeps its id, sku and stock

notes: --rename changes values in place: all variants keep their id. Non-destructive, so no dry-run/confirm round is required.

scenario: 一句话多处改规格 — 一次调用组合 --drop/--set/--rename/--set-price
input: 商品 13579 不要 lenses 这个规格了，只留 6lenses 的；款式只要 Ocean，改名叫 2 lenses；价格全部 19.9

semantic_rubric: ONE +set-variants call: --drop "lenses=6lenses" --set "Style:Ocean" --rename "Style:Ocean=2 lenses" --set-price 19.9 — not several calls in sequence
names the dimensions and values as they are now (Ocean in --set and on the left of --rename)
--set-price (every variant), not --new-price (which never changes existing prices)
destructive delete → previews with --dry-run, relays its "changes" list, and waits for the user's go-ahead before the real run

notes: Combined form: the edits apply in a fixed order (remove, drop, set, add, rename) and are written in one request, so one confirmation covers the whole sentence.

scenario: 去掉整个维度会合并变体 — 先问保留哪个值
input: 商品 13579 不按镜片数量分了，把 lenses 规格去掉

semantic_rubric: when lenses has several values, dropping it would merge variants — asks which value's variants to keep (the CLI refuses a bare --drop then and names the --drop "lenses=<value>" form)
does NOT pick a value on the user's behalf
once answered, uses --drop "lenses=<value>" in one call

notes: Ask-first: the value to keep is the merchant's decision; the other values' variants are deleted.

input: 给商品 24680 加 S/M/L 三个尺码，现在的变体都算 M 码；S 卖 20、M 卖 25、L 卖 30

semantic_rubric: ONE call: --add "Size:S,M,L" --existing "Size:M" --set-price "Size:S=20,M=25,L=30"
--set-price per value (M's existing variants are repriced to 25 too), not --new-price (which never touches the kept M variants)
does NOT fall back to hand-writing a variants array on products update

notes: Per-value price: the per-value form names one dimension of the edited matrix.
